clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12390, whose subject line describes delegating a reporting function to the Secretary of State concerning U.S. credit to Poland. Section 1 delegates to the Secretary of State the functions vested in the President by section 306 of the Supplemental Appropriations Act of 1982 (Public Law 97-257). No earlier express end was found.

Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12390, whose subject line describes delegating a reporting function to the Secretary of State concerning U.S. credit to Poland. Section 2 directs the Secretary of State, before making the determination and written reports referred to in that section 306, to confer with the Secretary of the Treasury and, as appropriate, the Secretary of Agriculture and other interested agency heads. No earlier express end was found.

Terminated by performance on issuance. Section 3 states that similar functions vested in the President by section 205 of Public Law 97-216 were delegated to the Secretary of State and that the Secretary’s performance of those functions is confirmed and ratified. The ratification was complete when the order was signed on 1982-10-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer), and it contains no continuing command; the ratified acts are a surviving consequence recorded under savings, and a later revocation does not show a first cessation of a command already performed. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked the order by number; it is a later event because this clause had already ended. No earlier end was found.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12390 (47 FR 47799, Federal Register of October 28, 1982; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed Delegation to the Secretary of State and signed October 25, 1982. It delegates the President’s functions under section 306 of Public Law 97-257 to the Secretary of State and ratifies the Secretary’s earlier performance of similar functions under Public Law 97-216. Inventory: three numbered sections, each recorded as one clause and confirmed against the full held text. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12390, whose subject line describes delegating a reporting function to the Secretary of State concerning U.S. credit to Poland. Sections 1 and 2 end on that date; section 3 is a ratification exhausted on issuance, so the whole-order end is the later date. Whether the statutory authority lapsed earlier is not established (the statutes are not held) and would be an unnamed instrument and a disclosed candidate only.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found no held text citing this order by number other than its own printings. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
